title: Color theory in design
intro: Color theory, along with its associated terminology, carries significant weight in all design curricula, especially from the perspective of a design scholar. Prospective designers should exhibit a comprehension of color and its associated terminology. The task of selecting colors is more intricate than initially perceived and contributes to design. To craft superior designs and utilize colors with precision, understanding the formation of colors and their mutual relationships is essential.

Color theory, in its own right, is both a scientific and artistic field, fostering entire careers as color or brand consultants. Primary colors form the basic foundations of color, embodying their most fundamental state. They are not the result of hue combinations. The three primary colors (red, blue, and yellow) are the elements of the color wheel. Hypothetically, all other colors derive from them through blending. These colors can be mixed to generate others, but they themselves are incapable of being produced by mixing other colors.
quote: Primary colors form the basic foundations of color, embodying their most fundamental state.
body: The concept of color harmony entails the strategic placement of colors, intended to optimize viewer perception. Arranged colors prompt a sense of pleasure in observers, whereas disarray in design can trigger feelings of chaos and repulsion. Secondary colors are shades produced by combining two primary colors.

title: Sandwiches and lemon juice
intro: The rise in the demand for sandwiches came about as our society became busier and had less time to devote to preparing and consuming meals. Quick, transportable, and affordable food became a necessity in a fast-paced industrial era. This shift can be seen even in our lunch habits today, most commonly consumed in our offices.

However, the concept of using some sort of bread or a bread-like item to support or encase different types of food has been prevalent in many ancient cultures across the globe. Despite changes, sandwiches have always remained in style, primarily owing to their convenience. Where we purchase them, their preparation methods, and their contents might have evolved, but the sandwich persists as a beloved comfort food and everyday snack. There's a unique pleasure in having a pre-packaged sandwich, whether it's a wrap picked up at the grocer or a restaurant burger, that far surpasses the satisfaction of making one at home. The conventional meat-and-bread combination is a widely beloved choice.
quote: Despite changes, sandwiches have always remained in style, primarily owing to their convenience.
body: Presently, we're spoiled for choice with a myriad of sandwich options, though a few like the grilled cheese and peanut butter and jelly are perennial favorites. Simple or gourmet, there's undoubtedly a sandwich variety to charm anyone and they come in all conceivable forms and sizes.

title: Relaxing sounds of nature
intro: The soothing undulations of untouched expanses, be it the unrelenting cadence of the ocean, the gentle thrum of a light drizzle, or the orchestrated melodies of bird songs, have remained a significant element of our existence. The perpetual nexus between humankind and the surroundings exerts a substantial impression. Harmonizing with Nature's harmonies refines our nighttime rest.

We acknowledge the soothing impact of Earth's melodious strains the lyrical song of a nightingale or the isolated hum of a raindrop brings peace, quieting our resonant heart rhythms. Our listening senses profoundly connect with our convictions, experiences, and sense of comfort. As we descend into slumber, the slightest sound can startle us into alertness, whether it be the slam of a car door, the creaking of a swinging gate, or the persistent hum of city life. Those who relish the sound banquet of chirping birds, or the sea's rhythm experienced expedited sleep onset and improved overall health.
quote: Our listening senses profoundly connect with our convictions, experiences, and sense of comfort.
body: Nonetheless, in modern times burdened with persistent noise and electronic interference, harnessing moments of peacefulness has transformed into a sought-after luxury. Arranged harmonies for tranquility instill focus, particularly when they are wordless, as lyrics might lead us toward mental activity instead of inducing tranquility.
